label: Adyghe cheese
note: Whole milk is heated to 93-95 °C and set with sour whey from the previous batch; unlike most cheese it does not melt when fried; eaten fresh, dried or smoked

about.text: A mild, crumbly fresh cheese of the North Caucasus made from heated cow milk curdled with sour whey and moulded in baskets; it does not melt when baked or fried.
